entities.summary: The KTM KL Sentral–Terminal Skypark Line is a currently suspended limited express train service in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia between Kuala Lumpur Sentral and Sultan Abdul Aziz Shah Airport. It is Malaysia's second airport rail link service, after the Express Rail Link system.
